scope: Finite-resource scheduled service beats, not measured RTL clocks. Float64 real-parameter trace; full N=T*P statistics domain for every h. Ordinary channel blocking, source retention and weight broadcast are strong controls.

resources.scope: Finite-resource Float64 service model; no RTL clock, SRAM macro, ASIC PPA or frozen-FP32 equivalence claim
resources.weight_layout: q4-sector-major,c-major,4 adjacent h/word; bank=(c+sector)%8. One stored weight layout; q1 consumes one component of this word.
resources.state_bank_ports: one shared read/write service per bank
resources.source_transpose_cache_ports: 8x128bit read and independent write paths; row-to-column transpose is separately scheduled
resources.wide_work_ports: 96 lane-local 64-bit read/write pairs, explicitly modeled register-bank capacity; not a foundry SRAM claim
resources.policy: All axes provision the same resource superset, including otherwise idle packet/popcount auxiliaries. One main resource point, no automatic parameter sweep. Ordinary channel blocking and source/weight ordering are controls, not claimed innovations.
resources.boundary: Packed captured source enters once and is retained to external backing, charged for every axis. Real checkpoint W is external readonly. End at final confirmed theta*g support/context delivery; FC2/BN2/shortcut and upstream source producer are outside this component.

limitations: Input source producer, downstream FC2/BN2/shortcut are outside this BN/PSN component.
The common platform provisions otherwise idle auxiliary units; no same-area claim.
Float64 observed support agreement is not a proof of original GPU FP32 equivalence.
Within each independent channel block, FIFO resource service is modeled; cross-block speculative overlap is not assumed.
